summary: Chronic hyperglycemia from insulin resistance with relative insulin deficiency; most adult cases, strongly linked to obesity/metabolic risk. Often asymptomatic at diagnosis (found on screening); symptomatic presentation includes polyuria, polydipsia, fatigue, blurred vision. ADA 2026 frames GLP-1 RA and SGLT2i therapy as disease-modifying, considered from diagnosis with strength scaling to ASCVD/HF/CKD risk, layered on lifestyle change and metformin rather than reserved as later add-ons (ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026, Sec. 9).

news.what: Mounjaro (tirzepatide) FDA-approved to reduce MACE risk in adults with T2D at high CV risk; SURPASS-CVOT (~13,000 pts, >4.5 yr) noninferior to dulaglutide on MACE-3 (HR 0.92, 95.3% CI 0.83-1.01) - first dual GIP/GLP-1 with this claim.
Awiqli (insulin icodec) FDA-approved; first once-weekly basal insulin for adults with T2DM, reducing basal injections from 7/week to 1 (ONWARDS program, ~2,680 pts).

Rybelsus (oral semaglutide) FDA-approved for MACE risk reduction in adults with T2D at high CV risk regardless of prior CV event - first oral GLP-1 RA with a MACE indication (SOUL trial, n=9,650, ~14% relative MACE reduction over ~4 yr).

Of 5,783 newly diagnosed adults across 60 West Michigan primary-care clinics (Apr 2021-Jan 2023), only 19.9% were prescribed an SGLT2i or GLP-1 RA within 3 months - barely higher in guideline-qualifying subgroups (ischemic heart disease 20.0%, eGFR<60 19.3%, BMI>=32 20.3%).

review.checked: 26 claims · 15 searches · all 7 cited FDA label PDFs downloaded and read directly

blocking.claim: Metformin row links to its FDA label
blocking.says: That URL is the label for SEGLUROMET (ertugliflozin + metformin), a fixed-dose SGLT2i/metformin combination — not metformin monotherapy. A clinician clicking the row lands on a two-drug product whose separate SGLT2i risks (DKA, Fournier's gangrene) the row does not disclose.

blocking.claim: Metformin boxed warning: renal impairment, sepsis, dehydration, alcohol, acute CHF
blocking.says: The label enumerates renal impairment, concomitant drugs, AGE 65 AND OVER, RADIOLOGICAL STUDIES WITH CONTRAST, surgery, hypoxic states, alcohol, hepatic impairment. Four label risk factors are omitted and three non-label terms substituted. The contrast hold is a routine decision this card would fail to prompt.

blocking.claim: Not on this card: Ozempic CKD indication unverified, no primary source
blocking.says: The card's own cited Ozempic label carries that indication in INDICATIONS AND USAGE. It is FDA-approved and documented in the source already on the card. The hedge became its own misinformation.
